about_the_game: Color Breakers is back, this time with even more colors to break! Invite your friends and enjoy cooperative (or competitive) multiplayer modes on dozens of levels designed for up to eight players - with procedurally generated paintings and gameplay twists in each level. And that’s not all: Fancy a story? Color Breakers 2 introduces a completely new story mode, using the procedural generation to keep it fresh with each playthrough.

short_description: A casual co-op game about coloring with friends! Form a party of up to eight players in local and online multiplayer and try to beat crazy levels by coloring procedurally-generated paintings. Expect fast-paced, chaotic fun with plenty of twists and turns to keep you entertained!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, French, Italian, Portuguese - Brazil
